en.config.hint.ask: Show a confirmation dialog before every deletion.
en.dialog.busyWarning: A reply is still generating; deleting will stop it first.
en.dialog.desc.message: This message leaves the model context and is hidden from the current transcript. The original session log stays untouched.
en.dialog.desc.reply: This reply leaves the model context together with its reasoning, tool calls and injected context; your prompt stays.
en.dialog.desc.step: This step and the tool results it requested leave the model context together; other steps in the same turn stay.
en.dialog.desc.turn: This turn (your prompt, injected context, every reply step and tool result) leaves the model context. Later turns stay exactly where they are and simply move up in the transcript.
en.dialog.extraWarning: This range also covers other content; confirming removes it as well.
en.dialog.note: Deletion only changes what the model sees next; the append-only log is never rewritten.
en.error.already-deleted: This content is already removed from the context.
en.error.busy: This session is working and cannot be stopped right now (a compaction may be running); try again in a moment.
en.error.forbidden: The request origin is not allowed.
en.error.invalid: Invalid request; refresh and try again.
en.error.nothing-to-delete: This turn has no reply content to delete.
en.error.range-not-clean: The target window contains unrelated content; the delete was cancelled.
en.error.session-not-active: This session is not open in DSH; open it first.
en.error.session-not-found: No session log was found for this id.
en.error.stale: The session just changed; try again.
en.error.stop-timeout: The running turn did not stop in time; try again in a moment.
